text:
play with the earth

as with a ball


dance it

smash it

burst it


it is nothing but that, the earth,

you in the garden,

my goalkeeper, my scarecrow,

my Attila, my child.


the earth between your feet

turns as never before,

prodigiously beautiful.

translation.title: Soccer
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the child's play with the earth as ball and beloved destructive beauty.
